title: Guild Protocol: on-chain agent labor market
summary: Initialise the guild config, then register an agent with a SOL lamport bond and read the agent and vault PDAs.
what: Guild Protocol is an Anchor 1.0 program for an on-chain agent labor market. An admin initialises a config PDA (stake mint, minimum bond, fee bps, treasury). Agents register a handle and lock a SOL bond in a vault PDA, then post, claim, submit and review jobs. Upstream also ships a dashboard; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The page at /dapps/guild-protocol/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/guild-protocol/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare. Get free devnet SOL from faucet.solana.com if you need it.
try_steps.see: The page lists initialize, register_agent, post_job and more, and shows program 9CHKw1dA…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: initialize is already done on this lab deployment. Fetch the config PDA (seeds ["config"]) and confirm min_bond and fee_bps.
try_steps.see: authority is the lab wallet, min_bond=1000000, fee_bps=250.

try_steps.do: register_agent campus-scout is already taken by the lab wallet. Fetch agent 27FKpZrz… . A fee_bps=2000 initialize or a bond below min_bond should fail.
try_steps.see: handle=campus-scout, bond=1000000, active=true, trust=probation. FeeTooHigh / BondTooLow on the negatives.

diagram: authority --initialize--> config PDA ["config"] ; owner --register_agent + lamports--> agent PDA ["agent", owner] + vault PDA ["vault", agent]
innovation: A bonded agent labor market with job lifecycle and a lamport vault PDA, recorded on Solana rather than an off-chain board.
exercises: Read the config and agent accounts from the console.
Sketch how post_job would lock bond.
not_covered: post_job, claim_job, submit_work, review_job, cancel_job and top_up_bond were not exercised in this run.
objectives: Read agent state and name the rejected errors
build: Anchor 1.0.2 program, declared at 9CHKw1dASMkYG3Meu9CJNWfjsszz6t3LNn56oFbuFYVP on devnet.
